This Direct Hire role features:- Great compensation up to $45.00/hr- Great company benefits - Excellent work environment
Responsibilities:- Communicate effectively with clients in both English and Spanish to understand their needs and concerns- Negotiate with insurance companies and opposing parties to secure fair settlements for our clients- Conduct thorough investigations into accidents and injuries, including gathering evidence and obtaining medical records- Collaborate with attorneys and legal team members to develop case strategies and prepare for negotiations and litigation- Maintain detailed records of all communications, negotiations, and case developments
Requirements:- Fluency in both English and Spanish (MUST)- Previous experience working on the plaintiff side of personal injury cases (MUST)- Strong negotiation skills and the ability to advocate effectively for clients- Excellent communication, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills- Detail-oriented with the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines- Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience
